MODERN HOME EQUIPPED with MODERN APPLIACES and SOLAR PANELS!!!

Welcome to 106 W Little Dipper Dr, a stunning and meticulously maintained home that exudes comfort and convenience. Step into the bright and airy open-concept living space, featuring a well-appointed kitchen with granite countertops, a spacious center island, and a breakfast bar that seamlessly flows into the expansive living room - perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. The primary bedroom is a peaceful retreat, boasting a tiered ceiling and a luxurious ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub and a separate shower, as well as walk-in double closets providing ample storage space.

This home is equipped with modern amenities including SOLAR PANELS, ensuring energy efficiency and peace of mind. The sunroom offers a tranquil space to enjoy the natural surroundings, while the large covered patio with gutters extends the living area outdoors for al fresco dining and relaxation. Additionally, the property features ceiling fans in all bedrooms, the living room, and the sunroom, along with an alarm system, walk-in pantry, and WASHER and DRYER included.
Don't miss the opportunity to call this your home.
